prompts.prompt:
Use case: product-mockup. Asset type: finished photorealistic 3D digital music collection book mockup for a Brazilian violin sheet-music shop landing page, on a TRUE TRANSPARENT background.
Primary request: A premium substantial upright hardback book in three-quarter view, left spine visible, mostly frontal and easy to read, perfectly straight upright, not a flat tilted rectangle. Reference aesthetic: midnight navy leather hardcover, fine metallic gold double-line border around the cover, warm orange and golden concert bokeh printed into the bottom half of the cover, large realistic polished wooden violin and bow printed into the lower half of the front cover, elegant large condensed serif white and metallic gold titles in the upper half. Premium editorial 3D product advertising, very detailed and polished, realistic thickness, textured cover, embossed details. The front cover should be large and take up most of the image. A few cream sheets of engraved music lean against the book's lower RIGHT edge, only covering the lowest corner so all title text is unobscured. Small gentle contact shadow beneath objects, transparent everywhere else. Center entire book and sheets with comfortable transparent margins, no objects cut off. Portrait composition, 4:5 or 3:4. Warm studio lighting, luxurious. All cover text typeset cleanly, no skewing errors.
Brand top: a small orange line drawing of a violinist next to a white lowercase stacked wordmark reading exactly "music library." The orange period is part of the wordmark.
Do not add any UI, cards, ribbons outside the book, prices, headphones, floating icons, tablets, numbers of songs, unrelated instruments, watermarks, or extra cover text.
Cover text hierarchy, verbatim: top small "ACERVO COM", center huge gold "100 PARTITURAS", next white "PARA VIOLINO", small subtitle "Do clássico ao popular". Bottom discreet "SUA MÚSICA COMEÇA AQUI". A single principal violin on the cover.
